parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the roles of the sinoatrial node (SAN) and the atrioventricular node (AVN) in the initiation and control of the cardiac cycle.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The Purkyne fibres pass down the septum and extend to the cardiac muscle at the base (apex) of the heart.

Explain why it is important that the Purkyne fibres extend to the base of the heart.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The activity of the SAN is controlled by the nervous system. Noradrenaline is released by nerve cells in the SAN.

Fig. 4.1 shows the role of noradrenaline in causing calcium ions ($Ca^{2+}$) to enter a cell in the SAN.

{{figure:figure_4_1.png}}

With reference to Fig. 4.1, outline the process of cell signalling.
